datasets.name: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (feature centre points)
datasets.organization: IAU Working Group for Planetary System Nomenclature / USGS Astrogeology Science Center
datasets.purpose: Names, types, sizes, centre coordinates and name origins of surface features labelled on planets, moons and minor planets
datasets.mechanism: GIS download (KMZ per target body) -> curated selection -> compact JSON
datasets.query: MOON_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, MERCURY_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, VENUS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, MARS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, IO_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, EUROPA_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, GANYMEDE_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, CALLISTO_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, TITAN_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, ENCELADUS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, MIMAS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, IAPETUS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, TETHYS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, DIONE_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, RHEA_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, MIRANDA_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, ARIEL_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, TITANIA_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, TRITON_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, PLUTO_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, CHARON_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, CERES_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, VESTA_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, PHOBOS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz, EROS_nomenclature_center_pts.kmz
datasets.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work, USGS); IAU nomenclature is freely usable. Cite the Gazetteer.
datasets.citation: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, International Astronomical Union (IAU) Working Group for Planetary System Nomenclature (WGPSN), USGS Astrogeology Science Center. https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov
datasets.rateLimits: Static files on Amazon S3; one sequential download per body, cached in data-raw/features.
datasets.updateCadence: continuously as the IAU approves names
datasets.normalization: Longitudes converted from 0-360 east to (-180, 180] east; planetocentric latitudes kept; zero diameters stored as null (unknown); a curated subset of notable features with importance ranks and short descriptions added by the Cosmos team.
datasets.limitations: Centre points only (no outlines). Positions are placed on a sphere of the body's mean radius, so markers on very irregular bodies (Eros, Vesta's south pole) sit above or below the true surface.

datasets.name: Mission landing sites and informal features (literature compilation)
datasets.organization: Cosmos team compilation from LROC, NASA NSSDCA and mission papers
datasets.purpose: Landing-site markers (Apollo, Luna, Surveyor, Chang'e, Chandrayaan-3, Viking, Mars rovers and landers, Venera, Huygens, NEAR) and informal features (South Pole-Aitken, Mordor Macula, the Great Red Spot)
datasets.mechanism: Manual compilation of published coordinates (cited per record)
datasets.license: Facts (coordinates) from cited publications; compilation released with the project.
datasets.citation: Wagner, R. V. et al. (2017) Icarus 283, 92-103 (LROC coordinates of anthropogenic features); NASA NSSDCA Master Catalog; mission papers cited per record.
datasets.limitations: Venera and Luna 9 positions are approximate (to about a degree). The Great Red Spot's longitude is extrapolated from a published drift rate.
